Why are you being asked to complete this form?

We are a federal contractor or subcontractor. The law requires us to provide equal employment opportunity to qualified people with disabilities. We have a goal of having at least 7% of our workers as people with disabilities. The law says we must measure our progress towards this goal. To do this, we must ask applicants and employees if they have a disability or have ever had one. People can become disabled, so we need to ask this question at least every five years.

Completing this form is voluntary, and we hope that you will choose to do so. Your answer is confidential. No one who makes hiring decisions will see it. Your decision to complete the form and your answer will not harm you in any way. If you want to learn more about the law or this form, visit the U.S. Department of Labor’s Office of Federal Contract Compliance Programs (OFCCP) website at .

How do you know if you have a disability?

A disability is a condition that substantially limits one or more of your “major life activities.” If you have or have ever had such a condition, you are a person with a disability. Disabilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Alcohol or other substance use disorder (not currently using drugs illegally)
  • Autoimmune disorder, for example, lupus, fibromyalgia, rheumatoid arthritis, HIV/AIDS
  • Blind or low vision
  • Cancer (past or present)
  • Cardiovascular or heart disease
  • Celiac disease
  • Cerebral palsy
  • Deaf or serious difficulty hearing
  • Diabetes
  • Disfigurement, for example, disfigurement caused by burns, wounds, accidents, or congenital disorders
  • Epilepsy or other seizure disorder
  • Gastrointestinal disorders, for example, Crohn's Disease, irritable bowel syndrome
  • Intellectual or developmental disability
  • Mental health conditions, for example, depression, bipolar disorder, anxiety disorder, schizophrenia, PTSD
  • Missing limbs or partially missing limbs
  • Mobility impairment, benefiting from the use of a wheelchair, scooter, walker, leg brace(s) and/or other supports
  • Nervous system condition, for example, migraine headaches, Parkinson’s disease, multiple sclerosis (MS)
  • Neurodivergence, for example, attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), autism spectrum disorder, dyslexia, dyspraxia, other learning disabilities
  • Partial or complete paralysis (any cause)
  • Pulmonary or respiratory conditions, for example, tuberculosis, asthma, emphysema
  • Short stature (dwarfism)
  • Traumatic brain injury

Responsabilidades del Puesto
1. Supervisión de las Operaciones Diarias:
Garantizar que las actividades de carga, almacenamiento, programación, despacho y control de inventario se realicen de manera eficiente, alineándose con los objetivos organizacionales yminimizando cualquier interrupción operativa.

Supervisar y liderar al equipo de la terminal, incluyendo las operaciones, el mantenimiento y el personal administrativo. Fomentar un ambiente de trabajo colaborativo que promueva el desarrollo profesional y la motivación del equipo.
3. Cumplimiento de Normativas
Asegurar que todas las operaciones cumplan con las normas de salud, seguridad, medio ambiente y regulación, implementando y monitoreando procedimientos para mantener estándares elevados.
Liderar la implementación de cultura de seguridad en las operaciones, realizando investigaciones de incidentes, auditando sistemáticamente las instalaciones, gestionando las actividades de riesgo guiando al personal involucrado en un estándar de excelencia operacional. Minimizar impactos negativos en las operaciones.
4. Mantenimiento y Reparación de Infraestructura
Coordinar el mantenimiento y las reparaciones de la infraestructura de la terminal, tales como tanques, tuberías, equipos de carga/descarga y sistemas de seguridad, garantizando su óptimo funcionamiento y prolongando su vida útil.
5. Administración del Presupuesto
Desarrollar y gestionar el presupuesto de la terminal, controlando los costos relacionados con la dotación de personal, mantenimiento, equipos y energía, para asegurar una eficiente utilización de los recursos.
6. Coordinación con Stakeholders
Mantener una comunicación efectiva y continua con proveedores, clientes, compañías navieras, reguladores y contratistas para asegurar la continuidad operativa y fomentar relaciones comerciales sólidas.
7. Monitoreo e Implementación de Mejoras
Monitorear las métricas de rendimiento operativo y ejecutar mejoras en los procesos paramaximizar la productividad y la rentabilidad, apoyándose en análisis de datos y feedback del equipo.
8. Gestión de Emergencias y Riesgos
Desarrollar y ejecutar planes de manejo de emergencias, garantizar la preparación a través de simulacros, mantener el equipo de emergencia y liderar los esfuerzos de respuesta durante los incidentes.
9. Informes Operativos
Preparar y presentar informes operativos detallados a la alta dirección, proporcionando una visión clara y precisa del estado de las operaciones y proponiendo soluciones estratégicas para mejorar el desempeño.
10. Representación y Relaciones Públicas Mantener relaciones sólidas con los grupos de interés y representar a la empresa en reuniones regulatorias, defendiendo los intereses de la organización y buscando siempre el cumplimientode las normativas vigentes.

2. Conocimiento de software de operaciones de terminales, sistemas SCADA, gestión de inventarios y sistemas de gestión de seguridad.
3. Control de costos, cronogramas y recursos.

Res. 120/2017, Res. 951/2015, Res. 785/05.
API 1160, 510, 570, 653, 650, 1104, 581, 579.

NACE SP0169, SP0208, SP0507.
DNVGL ST F101 y OCIMF
IMO, ISGOTT, MARPOL


Competencias Personales
1. Capacidad demostrada para gestionar equipos, coordinarse con grupos de interés y comunicarse eficazmente a través de departamentos y con reguladores

2. Capacidad para trabajar de manera colaborativa en entornos interdisciplinarios, manteniendo una comunicación efectiva y proactiva.

3. Comprensión sólida de las normativas de salud, seguridad y medio ambiente, así como de los requisitos de cumplimiento en el almacenamiento y manejo de petróleo

4. Habilidades analíticas, gestión de proyectos, presupuestación y familiaridad con tecnologías emergentes como la inteligencia artificial en logística son ventajosas

Formación Académica
1. Título universitario en ingeniería (mecánica, petróleo, electromecánica, química o afín),
2. Inglés técnico intermedio o superior (lectura de normas, reportes, interacción con proveedores internacionales).
3. 10 años en operaciones de terminales de petróleo/gas, almacenamiento con responsabilidad progresiva. Especialmente en operaciones marítimas de importación/exportación de hidrocarburos mediante muelles o monoboyas.

Beneficios

La empresa ofrece una excelente oportunidad de desarrollo profesional en un marco de muy buenas condiciones laborales.

VMOS es una compañía logística de exportación de petróleo que tiene a su cargo un megaproyecto de infraestructura destinado a transportar el crudo producido en la Cuenca Neuquina hasta la costa atlántica de Río Negro. Allí se construye una nueva terminal marítima de exportación. VMOS es una Sociedad Anónima, conformada por nueve accionistas: YPF, Vista, PAE, Pampa Energía, Chevron, Pluspetrol, Shell y Tecpetrol y GyP de Neuquén.

El oleoducto permitirá el transporte desde el corazón productivo de Vaca Muerta hasta una instalación con capacidad para operar buques petroleros tipo VLCC (Very Large Crude Carriers).

Most importantly, in all we do we live our values:

  • Act as One Team by fostering inclusion, collaboration, and respect
  • Drive for Excellence by being agile, innovative, and efficient
  • Do What's Right by acting safely, ethically, and sustainably

Overview

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Senior Data Scientist with strong expertise in predictive and prescriptive modeling applied to industrial operations to join our growing team. As a Senior Data Scientist, you will be responsible for developing models to solve business problems, communicating with the technical team, and ensuring that deliverables meet business expectations. You will also work with cross-functional teams to identify and prioritize data analytics initiatives.

Main Accountabilities

  • Design, develop, test, and implement complex models and algorithms that drive analytical solutions across the organization.
  • Provide technical support to data scientists across multiple squads.
  • Collaborate with business analysts to understand business problems and implement scalable solutions.
  • Define development standards and solution approaches.
  • Design and structure reusable codebases.
  • Coordinate with MIS, Digital Specialists, and Data Engineers to deliver comprehensive analytical solutions.
  • Communicate the design, functioning, and outputs of analytical models and solutions.
  • Ensure timely analysis and testing for ongoing maintenance of solutions.
  • Present data insights to stakeholders.

Knowledge and Technical Competencies

  • Make decisions aligned with Bunge’s strategy, business needs, and financial goals, fostering innovation.
  • Build strong relationships, influence others effectively, and develop talent.
  • Develop data-driven strategies aligned with company priorities and communicate clearly to energize teams.
  • Proficient in data science, machine learning, programming languages like Python or R, SQL, data analysis, and teamwork.
  • Assist in structuring business problems and hypotheses for advanced analytics, including machine learning and optimization.
  • Help business units understand data science concepts for better communication and implementation.

Education/Experience

  • Advanced knowledge in math, analytics, and computer science, with expertise in machine learning, statistical models, and data science programming.
  • Avoid common pitfalls, write reusable and resilient code, build data pipelines in cloud environments, and ensure data quality.
  • Mentor junior staff and communicate effectively with stakeholders and management.
  • Demonstrate teamwork and innovative thinking.

Bunge (NYSE: BG) is a global leader in sourcing, processing, and supplying oilseed and grain products. We operate numerous port terminals, processing plants, and facilities.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring a Head of Cloud Alliances to lead business development and partnerships with the global public clouds. As the publisher of Ubuntu, Canonical is already a trusted partner with the leading guest OS and select services for the major hyperscalers. We have a large portfolio of open source software on the cloud marketplace for enterprise customers, and are looking to expand our global cloud partnerships.
Reporting to the VP of Global Alliances, the Global Head of Cloud Alliances will lead teams that bring innovation to the public cloud platforms, joint go-to-market with public cloud sales communities and marketplaces, and our global customer and partner contracts. They will work closely with cloud partners, from engineering to product management and marketing, to deliver open source solutions at scale for their cloud customers.
Our Cloud Alliance team builds trusted relationships with partners at all levels, from joint technical work to executive strategy. Their goal is to increase Canonical market share in the cloud ISV ecosystem, develop cloud channel sales, evangelize the partnership and lead all business interactions. The Global Head of Cloud Alliances will own the strategy, sell-to, sell-through and sell-with motions with all cloud partners, as well as promotion of our cloud related activities - from campaigns, to strategic opportunities and cloud related events.
Our company is largely distributed, this role can be based anywhere in the Americas or EMEA.
The role entails

  • Taking ownership of Canonical's global cloud partner strategy, leading efforts to forecast, driving bookings, and growing revenue worldwide
  • Building strong, cross-functional relationships across teams to ensure a unified approach to technology and market execution

  • Coordinating with outside counsel and internal operations, business, controls, and legal teams to address operational feasibility considerations at all stages of the loan product life cycle

title: Entrevista a un arquitecto expatriado: Jon (Brasil)
description:
"al final con empeño las cosas acaban saliendo bien, y Brasil es un país ideal para intentarlo en estos momentos." HoyarquiPARADOS entrevistamos a Jon, arquitecto español que se encuentra actualmente trabajando en Brasil. Os dejamos con su experiencia:

"al final con empeño las cosas acaban saliendo bien, y Brasil es un país ideal para intentarlo en estos momentos." HoyarquiPARADOS entrevistamos a Jon, arquitecto español que se encuentra actualmente trabajando en Brasil. Os dejamos con su experiencia: Hola Jon, dinos ¿Qué situación te hizo tomar la decisión de dar el salto?
Una vez terminada la carrera, me salió una beca para hacer prácticas de trabajo durante seis meses en el extranjero. Sin dudarlo, y teniendo en cuenta la situación en España, busque una empresa en Brasil que estuviera interesada en acogerme durante ese período y me marché.
Tuve relativa facilidad para encontrar la empresa, ya que un compañero que había vivido en Brasil me pasó un par de referencias, y teniendo en cuenta que suponía mano de obra gratis, pocas empresas podían rechazarlo.
¿Cómo fueron los inicios? Facilidades y problemas al llegar.
A pesar de la facilidad para encontrar el despacho donde trabajar, el tema del visado fue un quebradero de cabeza. Existe una ley brasileña que impide a las empresas contratar a más de un extranjero por cada brasileño.
Además, los trámites para regularizar a un empleado, incluso uno en prácticas temporales, es muy engorroso y si la empresa no es relativamente grande suele costar que se metan en semejante berenjenal.
Por si eso fuera poco, los despachos de arquitectura suelen contratar a pocos empleados fijos aquí, ya que la movilidad es bastante grande, y suelen hacer contratos tipo freelance incluso a los locales, lo cual dificulta enormemente poder gestionar un visado de trabajo .
Además, los consulados de Brasil en España no son muy colaborativos, te obligan a desplazarte hasta Madrid o Barcelona para cualquier cosa, no responden mails ni teléfono y ofrecen pocas soluciones.
Total, después de muchos intentos y probar diferentes opciones, tuve que viajar a Brasil como turista (para lo cual también es necesario juntar algunos papeles).
Tuve la suerte de tener un amigo allí que me acogió hasta que encontré un piso para residir, cosa que es también bastante engorrosa y muy cara en las principales ciudades del país.
Por lo demás, la adaptación fue muy buena. La gente es extraordinariamente amable y te ayuda siempre que puede. El idioma no es un problema , en poco más de un mes me comunicaba sin problemas con la gente y en el trabajo, y hasta entonces, el portuñol resulta bastante práctico.
¿Cuántotiempo llevas trabajando de arquitecto en Brasil?
Hasta la fecha llevo casi ocho meses en Brasil y la verdad estoy muy contento. Conseguí permanecer en el despacho en el que hice las prácticas, donde hago lo que me gusta.
Tocamos temas tanto de urbanismo como de arquitectura , encargos y concursos, con lo que el trabajo suele ser variado. Aún así, predominan los proyectos de concurso público relacionados con las intervenciones y mejora de las comunidades o favelas .
Actualmente se están llevando a cabo muchas obras relacionadas con los eventos deportivos próximos, Copa del Mundo, etc., pero muchos de estos encargos están adjudicados a dedo, por lo que los despachos que pueden aprovechar esta oportunidad son la minoría. La corrupción está, aquí también, a la orden del día.
Por lo demás, como sucedió en España, está habiendo unboom en la construcción de complejos turísticos en la costa, pero este tipo de obras (bastante discutibles moral y medioambientalmente) suelen llevarlas en su gran mayoría las constructoras.
¿Notas mucha diferencia en la forma de proyectar?
En general, la calidad de la arquitectura en Brasil esmuy inferior a la de España, al igual que su formación, exceptuando casos aislados.
Ello hace que muchos despachos desarrollen un trabajo de nivel medio-bajo y eso produce que otros que podrían aspirar a hacerlo mejor no lo hacen por falta de "competencia", ¿para qué esforzarse más si sabes que el de al lado no va a hacerlo mejor que tú?
Aún así, esa mentalidad está cambiando poco a poco y la llegada demuchos extranjeros (especialmente europeos) al mundo laboral brasileño está haciendo que el proceso se acelere y el nivel de exigencia mejore.
¿Te consideras bien remunerado?
En estos momentos estoy cobrando un sueldo bajo, como empleado junior, pero es lo justo para llegar a final de mes sin apuros yno me quejo . Las expectativas de mejora son buenas.

¿Qué grandes diferencias encuentras en la forma de vida con respecto a España?
Para mi, la mayor diferencia con España es "el ritmo ". Compartimos muchísimas cosas culturalmente y salvando las distancias el estilo de vida es similar, aún así, el tópico de esa despreocupación y tranquilidad brasileñas no son del todo mentira.
A veces resulta un incordio tanta tranquilidad (como cuando las cajeras del supermercado no van más rápido ni se estresan lo más mínimo a pesar de tener colas inmensas de gente esperando), pero uno se acostumbra a ello.
Para otras cosas, tiene su lado positivo, existe muchísimo menos estrés en el trabajo y la vida se lleva con más sosiego y calma.
¿Conoces muchos españoles por tu zona?
Como en todos los rincones del mundo, y más ahora que todos los jóvenes (y no tan jóvenes) estamos huyendo del país, hay una gran cantidad de españoles por Brasil, tanto de intercambio de estudios (la mayoría todavía) como trabajando.
Existen grupos de facebook de españoles donde la gente se pone en contacto para cosas varias, desde quedadas para ver los partidos de futbol hasta para buscar pisos de alquiler.
¿Nos recomendarías algún medio, para encontrar trabajo allí, desdeEspaña?
Creo que es complicado encontrar trabajo desde España en Brasil, aunque no imposible claro. A pesar de que hay mucho trabajo, se echa mucha mano de estudiantes en prácticas no remuneradas, lo cual disminuye la oferta.
Lo mejor suele ser presentarse en el país e ir un poco puerta a puerta buscando trabajo. Como en cualquier sitio, no es una tarea sencilla, pero por la experiencia de conocidos, la mayoría acaban encontrando alguna cosa.
Como comentaba anteriormente, los grupos de facebook pueden ser prácticos, siempre hay gente que conoce a gente que puede acabar echándote un cable!
¿Qué le dirías a un arquitecto que no encuentra trabajo enEspaña?
Animo a aquellos que no encuentran soluciones en España y que tienen recelo a salir a buscarse la vida por ahí a que lo hagan.
A pesar de que dar el paso suele costar un poco, al final con empeño las cosas acaban saliendo bien, y Brasil es un país ideal para intentarlo en estos momentos.
Existe un gran volumen de trabajo y aprecio por los arquitectos españoles, y aunque aún no hay muchas facilidades para regularizar el tema del visado y eso, parece que se están moviendo para cambiar eso también.
Por otro lado, mencionar que el mejor sitio para buscar un buen empleo, en cuanto a calidad de lo que se hace y la seriedad de los despachos (tema salarios, etc. también) es São Paulo .
Río de Janeiro suele ser el destino principal de la gente cuando viene a Brasil, y quizá precisamente por ello, el mercado está un poco más saturado, aunque también hay bastante empleo a raíz de la copa, las olimpiadas, etc.
En general, esas dos son las ciudades con más movimiento, aunque otras ciudades del sur también son buenas para intentar encontrar algo. El norte del país es más pobre y no hay tanto trabajo en el campo de la arquitectura.
¿Cómo ves el futuro de los arquitectos a nivelnacional e internacional?
En cuanto a la situación de la arquitectura en España y en el mundo, aunque mi opinión no sea más válida que la de ningún otro, opino que no va a ser más lo que hemos conocido hasta el momento. En España va a tener que transformarse en algo mucho más relacionado con conservar y mejorar lo que ya tenemos que con construir cosas nuevas.
En mi opinión, es el momento de echar la mirada atrás y ver lo que ha quedado del trabajo hecho los últimos años, las ciudades que hemos construido, si son o no el ideal que podíamos tener en nuestra cabezas y ver qué podemos hacer para equilibrar unas ciudades que han crecido sin medida y sin control.
Pensar nuevas soluciones para problemas pasados, muy vinculado con la sostenibilidad y las nuevas tecnologías, empezar a introducir en la arquitectura los avances hechos en esos campos en los últimos años y que por pereza y falta de visión no han sido incluidos en gran parte de lo hecho.
A nivel mundial, es difícil decir, seguramente predominarán la arquitectura empresarial y vinculada solo al crecimiento económico, sin tener en cuenta el crecimiento social, como viene siendo el caso.
Aún así, estamos en una época de cambio, de cambio en muchas cosas, y también en la arquitectura, y espero que muchas de las reclamaciones de libertad, participación, transparencia y concienciación que se están solicitando a nivel político acaben impregnando también en la arquitectura, y se convierta una profesión y un ejercicio mucho más concienciado, participativo y social de lo que es hoy en día.
¿Te arrepientes de haber tomado la decisión de irte? ¿Tienes fecha de vuelta?
No me arrepiento en absoluto de haber salido del país, tuve la oportunidad de hacerlo con un soporte que me facilito el paso, pero lo hubiera hecho igualmente de no haber sido así.
El destino de esa aventura no deja de ser decisión y preferencia de cada uno, qué cosas cada uno quiere explorar y conocer. Para mí Brasil ha sido un destino ideal, estoy aprendiendo muchas cosas que desconocía y que me interesan cantidad.
Tengo un trabajo del que vivir y con el que disfruto y he hecho muchas amistades, en el trabajo y fuera de él. Es un buen lugar, y creo que cada vez lo será más, para buscar un camino alternativo a la apatía y el desempleo.

description:
Quem somos?

Somos uma empresa de cibersegurança orientada a viabilizar as estratégias de negócios dos nossos clientes através de soluções seguras, flexíveis e inovadoras.

Atuamos no Brasil desde 1998, integrando soluções de última geração reconhecidas pelo Gartner, Forrester e pelos nossos clientes.

Descrição do cargo:

O Pós-Vendas será responsável por gerenciar a execução de serviços e contratos pós-venda, assegurando a entrega de soluções com qualidade e eficiência para os clientes. Atuará como o ponto de contato principal entre a empresa e seus clientes estratégicos, sendo responsável por monitorar e otimizar a operação de pós-venda, motivar a equipe interna, implementar estratégias de melhoria contínua, e garantir que todos os serviços sejam entregues dentro dos parâmetros acordados. O profissional deve possuir experiência em gestão de serviços, especialmente em tecnologia e cybersegurança, e ter habilidades para liderar, comunicar e resolver problemas de forma eficaz.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Gestão e monitoramento de serviços: Monitorar a eficácia do trabalho realizado pelos colaboradores da equipe comercial, administrando contratos e criando cronogramas de ações alinhados com as necessidades do cliente.
  • Planejamento e execução de estratégias: Criar e implementar estratégias para melhorar a eficiência dos serviços prestados ao cliente, garantindo que o time de accounts execute suas atividades com foco na qualidade e produtividade.
  • Motivação e alinhamento da equipe: Motivar e engajar as equipes internas, garantindo que todos estejam alinhados com os objetivos da empresa e das demandas específicas dos clientes estratégicos.
  • Gestão de relacionamento com clientes: Atuar como ponto focal de contato dos clientes, garantindo sua satisfação e levantando novas oportunidades comerciais. Estabelecer relações de longo prazo com executivos-chave e colaborar com a gerência sênior dos clientes.
  • Gestão de mudanças e requisitos de negócios: Garantir que as equipes de operações estejam cientes das mudanças no escopo do cliente e preparadas para atuar. Reconhecer as necessidades e exigências do negócio do cliente, garantindo o atendimento pleno de suas demandas.
  • Negociação e gestão de contratos: Auxiliar na negociação, fechamento e manutenção de contratos de serviços. Desenvolver, acompanhar e comunicar o cumprimento dos níveis de serviço (SLA) para contratos existentes.
  • Relatórios gerenciais e comunicação de melhorias: Revisar e apresentar relatórios gerenciais sobre os serviços prestados, incluindo logs de alertas, níveis de serviço, tickets abertos, consumo de nuvem, entre outros. Organizar, implementar e comunicar o status das melhorias técnicas e operacionais em andamento.
  • Responsabilidade pela satisfação do cliente: Ser responsável pela satisfação contínua do cliente e pelo sucesso das demandas que fazem parte do escopo contratual, incluindo pequenos projetos e ajustes operacionais.
  • Gestão financeira: Gerenciar os controles financeiros relacionados aos serviços prestados, garantindo a conformidade com o orçamento e a rentabilidade.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada na gestão de serviços de Tecnologia, com foco em serviços de cybersegurança.
  • Habilidades de liderança, motivação de equipes e gestão de pessoas.
  • Forte capacidade de planejamento e organização, com atenção a detalhes.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal, pois o profissional atuará como interface principal entre a empresa e os clientes.
  • Experiência na administração de contratos, controle de indicadores de performance e gestão de níveis de serviço (SLA).
  • Capacidade de resolução de problemas, especialmente em ambientes de alta complexidade técnica.

Certificações desejáveis (mas não eliminatório):

  • ITIL (Information Technology Infrastructure Library) - Certificação em boas práticas de gestão de serviços de TI.
  • PMP (Project Management Professional) - Certificação em gestão de projetos.
  • Certificação em Cybersegurança e Infraestrutura de TI.

Description
Amazon’s global Volunteering team is seeking an experienced Senior Product Manager who is extraordinary at understanding customer needs and delivering products at scale. You will drive community impact by inspecting, designing, and launching programs and products that motivate and enable Amazon employees to volunteer in communities where they live and work.
The Amazon Community Impact (ACI) team leads philanthropic initiatives focused on education, housing affordability, food security, disaster relief, and volunteering in communities across the globe ( Each year ACI’s Global Volunteering team inspires hundreds of thousands of Amazonians to volunteer which helps our communities, our planet, and future generations. We scale our volunteering impact through a network of leaders, community ambassadors, and volunteers at Amazon locations across the globe.
As the voice of our volunteering across Central and South Americas, you’ll be instrumental in understanding the unique needs of business leaders in the region, enabling the growth of community ambassadors, improving the volunteer experience, and scaling Amazon’s volunteering impact. We’re looking for someone with strong program management instincts who can own a product management lifecycle end-to-end. A successful candidate will proactively dive deep into varied customer personas, identify unmet needs, propose process improvements, define product requirements, manage the launch of new resources across the region, and bridge key information to centralized global functions. The Sr. Product Manager must excel at building deep relationships at every level of the company and can influence stakeholders, partners, and leaders in order to build consensus. They have a track record of delivering under ambiguity in a fast-paced, dynamic organization.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring engineering managers who are passionate about operational systems, open source technologies and cutting-edge hardware to lead engineering teams to enable and optimize Ubuntu for the latest x86, ARM, RISC-V, s390x and POWER systems.
We partner with the world's leading silicon vendors to optimise Ubuntu on their latest platforms. We integrate next-generation features and performance enhancements in Ubuntu while also ensuring a common operating experience for their users.
Engineering Managers should be outstanding developers themselves. They should be completely at home reviewing a patch or a software design spec. You will be expected to drive healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisations as well as lead your team to deliver high-quality design and code.
An Engineering Manager is responsible for line management and career guidance. The ability to develop engineering talent, to represent your team and product from a technical perspective, and to drive collaboration with other teams and customers are all critical to success in this role.
You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.
Location: This is a globally remote role. We have open positions in every time zone.

  • Oversee commercial engagements and support timely delivery on agreed project milestones
  • Participate as technical lead on complex customer engagements involving complete system architectures
  • Implement disciplined engineering processes

  • Optimize Ubuntu for latest hardware platforms
  • Display technical leadership internally and within our external communities
  • Contribute to code reviews and technical documentation
  • Be an active part of the leadership team, collaborating with other leaders

  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Fluency in C, C++, and Python

  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Thoughtfulness, and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
Nice-to-have skills
  • Experience working with open source communities and licenses
  • Computer architecture knowledge of x86, ARM, RISC-V or s390x
  • Understanding of build systems and toolchains, including for cross-compilation
  • Experience working with customers
  • Experience with board bring up and validation
  • Experience with Linux virtualization, networking or graphics stacks
  • Experience with one or more of the follow
  • Experience with Docker/OCI containers/K8s
  • ing technologies: confidential computing, RDMA, Infiniband and high performance computing.

What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

At CVS Health, we’re building a world of health around every consumer and surrounding ourselves with dedicated colleagues who are passionate about transforming health care.
As the nation’s leading health solutions company, we reach millions of Americans through our local presence, digital channels and more than 300,000 purpose-driven colleagues – caring for people where, when and how they choose in a way that is uniquely more connected, more convenient and more compassionate. And we do it all with heart, each and every day.
Title: Center Medical Director
Company: Oak Street Health
Location: Bethlehem, PA (1336 Catasauqua Rd, Bethlehem, PA 18017) OR
Scranton, PA (1078 S Washington Ave, Scranton, PA 18505)
Role Description
The purpose of the Center Medical Director role at Oak Street Health is to lead the clinical team at their center in providing the best patient care and a great place to work in order to keep patients happy, healthy and out of the hospital. The Medical Director will practice primary care in our clinics alongside their provider colleagues at 80% clinical time and 20% administrative time. The CMD will have mission-critical leadership responsibilities, which include setting an example for how thoughtful primary care is practiced, serving as a formal mentor, coach, and advisor to providers in Oak Street clinics, and participating in critical organizational-wide strategic initiatives.
Core Responsibilities
The Center Medical Director is the medical leader for his/her OSH center. In this role the CMD will have the following responsibilities:
Support of Organizational Strategy

  • Work in tight collaboration with the Practice Manager and Outreach Manager/Director to achieve our organizational objectives:
    • Best Care Anywhere
    • Unmatched Patient Experience
    • Exceptional Growth
    • Great Place to Work and Leader in DE&I
  • Drive implementation of OSH strategic initiatives.
  • Follow direction from regional leadership (regional medical director or senior medical director) in collaboration with CMDs in the region to implement regional priorities and reach regional objectives.
  • Cascade both organizational information to care team members as well as escalate care team concerns and ideas to the rest of the organization.
Provider Management
  • Help coordinate and lead the onboarding of new providers at the center.
  • Model excellent medical care, implementation of the care model, and success in metrics.
  • Support consistent and robust OSH care model implementation by ensuring care teams are effectively preparing for and executing daily huddles, patient care planning and management, admission prevention work, and clinical documentation workflows.
  • Ensure that the medical care provided by each provider and care team is appropriate evidence based care that keeps patients healthy and out of the hospital.
  • Understand, teach and implement Oak Street's clinical guidelines at both the individual provider and center level.
  • Support each care team and the center to provide the highest quality (primary and secondary) preventative care.
  • Educate and provide ongoing support for providers in implementation of the value based full risk model of care.
  • Assess and address root causes when center metric goals are not reached.
Leadership and Coaching
  • Create and maintain a culture of coaching up and growth of providers and care teams.
  • Listen to feedback from care team members and address concerns with constructive problem-solving.
  • Conduct performance reviews and discuss provider goals and help develop plans to achieve these goals.
Culture
  • Acknowledge and celebrate successes of care team members and communicate opportunities for improvement.
  • Achieve triad best practices.
  • Support a positive, Oaky culture of joy in practice.
  • Other duties as assigned.
What are we looking for?
Ideal Candidates Will Be
  • M.D., D.O., or A.P.N or P.A. graduates.
  • Board certification in Internal Medicine or Family Medicine required for M.D. or D.O., Board certification in Family, Adult, or Gerontology for A.P.N.
  • Experience in clinical leadership roles, leading and coaching providers to be the best they can be for their patients and their colleagues.

Director, General Manager - Latin America

Director, General Manager - Latin America

Join to apply for the Director, General Manager - Latin America role at Illumina

What if the work you did every day could impact the lives of people you know? Or all of humanity?
At Illumina, we are expanding access to genomic technology to realize health equity for billions of people around the world. Our efforts enable life-changing discoveries that are transforming human health through the early detection and diagnosis of diseases and new treatment options for patients.
Working at Illumina means being part of something bigger than yourself. Every person, in every role, has the opportunity to make a difference. Surrounded by extraordinary people, inspiring leaders, and world changing projects, you will do more and become more than you ever thought possible.
Position Summary
The General Manager, Latin America will be the face of the Illumina organization, setting out the strategic direction of the sub-region (Latin America) and ensuring alignment of the different Illumina functions.
A strategic, empowered leader who can drive the success of our business to support our local markets with local resourcing to maximize market opportunities. This leader is responsible for all customers within the geography across all customer segments.
This leader will be one of seven General Managers driving Illumina’s business in the Americas (Canada, Latin America, and United States).
Key relationships
Reports to: AMR Head of Region
Direct reports: District Sales Managers, Sales Specialists Managers
This leader will be part of the AMR Commercial Leadership Team, inclusive of 7 General Managers (5 for US, 1 for CAN, 1 for LATAM), Commercial Ops Leader, Marketing Leader, and Strategic Growth Leader
Key measures of success

  • Revenue attainment
  • Top line market growth
  • Margin expansion
  • P&L responsibilities
  • Aggregated strategic growth plans and execution against them
  • Employee satisfaction across all commercial functions
  • Customer satisfaction
Key Responsibilities
  • Leads Latin America business through a team of direct customer- facing functions: district sales and sequencing sales specialists as well as channel partners
  • Responsible for aligning and leveraging execution resources across commercial functions to maximize market adoption and success
  • Responsible for attainment of financial and strategic goals for the business within the geography in support of the company’s overall financial and strategic objectives
  • Drive accelerated and consistent revenue growth and market penetration in both life sciences and clinical market businesses
  • Lead and drive the genomics ecosystem within region by being responsible for developing commercial plans for advancing the company’s products and/or services to meet market demands within the geographic area of responsibility, working within the general financial plans provided by global commercial management and cross-functional counterparts
  • Within the geography, directs the sales of the organization’s products or services and develops the country/region’s go-to-market strategy in partnership with marketing and forecasts sales volumes
  • Has P&L responsibilities to decide on customer-facing resources to drive business
  • Works closely with global and other regional counterparts on critical strategic matters and business issues such as competitive positioning, new product launches, new product/solutions investments and governance for ‘global’ customers that span region
  • Build Illumina brand in region
  • Develop and ensure execution against KOL and government strategy for geography. Partnerships are key
  • Able to engage meaningfully with government and key industry leaders
  • Shape the Illumina company’s view on new market opportunities for the region
  • Identify, recruit, and retain top-notch talent that will drive the company's success, creating advancement opportunities and deepening a strong talent development culture that produces outstanding talent needed to sustain a growing enterprise. Ensure a leadership team reporting to them that can do the same to ensure we are cultivating the breadth and depth of leadership talent needed
  • Build a high-performance culture; ensure the organization is built with scalability and operational excellence in mind
  • Lead their geography with utmost integrity, modeling professionalism and ethical business and personal conduct always to ensure a full company compliance culture and safeguard the interest of Illumina and its shareholders
Critical Leadership Capabilities
Strategic Thinking:
A demonstrated ability to develop, manage, and when appropriate, alter a company’s market position to gain and maintain industry leadership in a rapidly changing environment through the synthesis of market trends, customer/partner requirements, competitive pressures, regulatory changes, and scientific and technical innovation.
Strategic and creative thinker with demonstrated problem solving experience to ensure seamless transition from strategic plan to operational execution.
Execution Orientation
A leader that consistently delivers financial and operational performance in a dynamic and challenging environment.
Develop a comprehensive operating plan that aligns functions and drives/delivers results, gain the buy-in of key stakeholders, manage the business to the achieve or exceed the plan, communicate the goals of the operating plan broadly to the team, and make the difficult decisions quickly to ensure fulfillment of operational and financial goals and commitments.
Team Leadership
Evidence of the ability to create and inspire high-performance teams is sought in the ideal candidate with the ability to make and influence all key talent decisions.
Cross-functional leadership and experience in other functions will enable the candidate to reinforce the performance-driven team culture, articulate the strategy to ensure the seamless execution, develop and motivate the team, and instill growth mindset to the team.
Other personal attributes
  • Excellent communication, collaboration and interpersonal skills and is the type of individual who engenders trust and commitment from key stakeholders within and outside an organization
  • Demonstrated experience in being able to manage and navigate the matrix environment
  • Is a people leader and an outgoing individual characterized by others as being influential and exhibiting a high level of integrity. They can also balance this with the ability to remain focused on milestones and objectives whilst being a good ambassador to the corporate/global functions
  • Demonstrates reputation for integrity and strong personal and professional ethics in all dealings, including strong executive presence
  • Is a “hands-on” individual with the ability to roll up their sleeves to make things happen, leveraging effective and strong decision-making experience
  • Is genuine in their approach to dealing with people, and can operate across all constituencies
  • Demonstrates high emotional intelligence and is naturally curious regarding business, technical and scientific innovations
  • Ability to deal with ambiguity and view and adapt challenges as opportunities
  • Highly driven and is known as being a dedicated executive who exhibits a passion for the business and the opportunities at hand
Experience/Education
  • Typically requires a bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 18 years of related experience, with 10+ years of Management experience

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
As the Software Engineering Manager for Ubuntu Gaming, your mission is to help make gaming on Ubuntu first-class. In this exciting time for Linux gaming, compatibility tools like Proton have matured, but a well-rounded gaming experience goes beyond compatibility. It entails maximising performance, robust and secure anti-cheat mechanisms, full device support, and ease of content creation, sharing and discovery. By collaborating with open-source projects and other partners, you'll contribute to not just Ubuntu but the wider Linux gaming ecosystem.
Location: This role will be based remotely in the Americas or EMEA region.
The role entails

  • Leading your team in optimising and expanding the Ubuntu gaming experience, focusing on the Steam Snap.
  • Managing project timelines, balancing feature improvements with deadlines.
  • Collaborating with stakeholders to align your team's work with other teams and company objectives.
  • Conducting keen-eyed code reviews, focusing on quality, performance, and modern design principles.
  • Collaborating with upstream projects like Proton and partners like Unity to enhance Ubuntu's gaming capabilities.
  • Working closely with other teams to ensure a cohesive and comprehensive Ubuntu experience.
  • Driving performance improvements across a wide range of hardware.
  • Engaging actively with the open source and gaming community to gather feedback and collaborate on improvements.
What we are looking for in you
  • An undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path.
  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively with upstream projects and partners.
  • Familiarity and experience with the Linux graphics stack spanning user-space components to low level kernel drivers.
  • Exceptional software project management skills, encompassing risk assessment and resource allocation.
  • Ability to balance technical leadership with effective team management.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for both internal and external interactions.
  • Robust planning skills, demonstrated by your capacity to manage multi-cycle improvements.
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
Nice-to-have skills
  • A passion for technology and gaming, driving you to work with intelligent, motivated colleagues.
  • Initiative in proactively identifying opportunities and solving challenges.
  • Curiosity, flexibility, and a strong sense of accountability.
  • A focus on soft skills, including passion, enterprise, and self-motivation.
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Frentista - São Mateus
description:
O frentista desempenha um papel vital em um posto de combustível, sendo frequentemente a primeira impressão que os clientes têm da qualidade do serviço. No Grupo Schueng, buscamos profissionais que sejam atenciosos, carismáticos, pacientes e possuam excelente comunicação. Aqui, atender o cliente não é apenas uma tarefa; é uma oportunidade para criar uma experiência memorável que exemplifique os mais altos padrões de excelência do Grupo Schueng.

Além de atender com simpatia e profissionalismo, o frentista deve também ser um vendedor habilidoso , capaz de identificar as necessidades dos clientes e oferecer soluções que agreguem valor. Essa habilidade vai além de uma simples transação; é sobre construir relacionamentos e criar confiança.

No Grupo Schueng, reconhecemos e recompensamos o esforço de nossos frentistas. Por isso, criamos um programa exclusivo de vendas que permite aos colaboradores participar dos lucros das vendas de produtos (exceto combustíveis), possibilitando alcançar níveis de comissão muito acima do mercado atual.

Para integrar nossa equipe, é indispensável ter, no mínimo, o ensino médio completo e realizar cursos especializados, como NR20, atendimento ao cliente, NR07, NR09 e NR23. Esses treinamentos garantem a preparação técnica e a segurança necessárias para desempenhar a função com excelência.

A soma dessas qualidades e habilidades transforma o frentista do Grupo Schueng em um verdadeiro embaixador de nossa missão: proporcionar atendimento de qualidade, com eficiência e dedicação, sempre pensando no melhor para o cliente.

Trabalhar como frentista no Grupo Schueng vai muito além do abastecimento. Você será uma peça fundamental para garantir a satisfação dos clientes e a excelência dos serviços prestados. Suas principais atividades incluem:

  1. Abastecer veículos: Realizar o abastecimento de forma segura e eficiente, garantindo a satisfação e confiança do cliente.
  2. Atender clientes: Realizar o atendimento seguindo o padrão de excelência do Grupo Schueng, iniciando sempre com um caloroso: "Seja bem-vindo ao Grupo Schueng". Demonstrar cordialidade, atenção e criar uma experiência agradável em cada interação.
  3. Auxiliar no pagamento: Orientar os clientes sobre formas de pagamento e operar sistemas de recebimento com precisão.
  4. Limpar e manter veículos: Realizar pequenos serviços de limpeza, como o para-brisas, para proporcionar um diferencial no atendimento.
  5. Verificar a qualidade do combustível: Garantir que o combustível esteja em conformidade com os padrões de qualidade do Grupo Schueng.
  6. Calibrar pneus: Ajudar os clientes a manterem a segurança de seus veículos com o ajuste adequado da pressão dos pneus.
  7. Trocar óleo: Oferecer serviços de troca de óleo com cuidado e profissionalismo, sempre respeitando as necessidades do cliente.
  8. Limpar para-brisas: Proporcionar maior visibilidade e segurança aos motoristas com um serviço simples, mas eficiente.
  9. Testar a iluminação dos automóveis: Auxiliar na verificação de faróis, lanternas e outros sistemas de iluminação dos veículos.
  10. Organizar e manter todas as dependências da unidade limpas: Garantir um ambiente sempre limpo, organizado e convidativo para os clientes e colaboradores.
  11. Responsabilidade em cada abastecimento: Cada vez que você realiza um abastecimento, está assumindo um papel essencial na experiência do cliente. É fundamental garantir que o combustível correto (gasolina, diesel, etanol ou outros) seja utilizado com total atenção e que o valor recebido esteja exato, garantindo a precisão do seu turno no sistema de controle.
  12. Zelar por equipamentos: Cuidar dos patrimônios da unidade é uma responsabilidade essencial que reflete seu compromisso com a excelência. Manter os equipamentos em bom estado, prevenindo danos e preservando sua funcionalidade, é uma atitude que garante a qualidade do serviço e a segurança de todos.

Essas atividades e muitas outras que podem não estar aqui listadas são realizadas com o suporte dos nossos padrões rigorosos de qualidade e segurança e o líder da unidade, que refletem o compromisso do Grupo Schueng em oferecer um serviço diferenciado e de excelência.

title: Head of LATAM Communications
description:
Responsibilities
The Global Communications team at TikTok is responsible for all external communications related to the company. We're currently looking for a dynamic senior communications leader to join our fast-paced Global Communications team. As Head of Communications for Latin America, you will be responsible for providing ongoing counsel and partnership to the company's senior leaders across the region, while leading, inspiring and motivating a highly-engaged team.
We're looking for a dynamic leader with strong experience working in the technology industry. At TikTok, our leaders are also doers and you have proven experience conceptualizing, planning, and executing projects that have meaningful business impact. You're able to effectively manage through complex decisions and challenges, using sound judgment and expertise to mitigate risks and ensure the best outcomes. You are familiar with the media, regulatory and policy, as well as competitive landscape across the region and, as such, are able to effectively develop strategies to manage issues and mitigate risk, while ensuring balance between consumer and creative campaigns and reactive response efforts. As a strategic leader, you will work closely with other teams across the Global Brand & Comms department, including Marketing and CSR, as well as with our cross-functional partners — Product, Legal and Public Policy —to create cohesive and compelling communication strategies.
Ideal candidates are resilient, entrepreneurial-minded leaders who work well in an ever-evolving environment. You have strong media relationships. You collaborate with ease across teams and are able to weigh big picture objectives with immediate business needs. You're good at connecting the dots and you thrive in an entrepreneurial environment. And you lead with a compassionate, people-first mindset. This role reports to the Head of Global Corporate Communications.
Responsibilities:
- Advance the team's business objectives and enhance and protect corporate reputation in support of building our brand.
- Develop regional communication strategies that provide clear direction for the company's key initiatives.
- Build strong creative consumer campaigns, in partnership with Marketing, that help grow brand affinity.
- Create and lead strategies to effectively identify and mitigate early-stage crises while also effectively managing other potential risks to the company.
- Identify strategic priorities across the region aligned with cross-functional partners and mapped to overall business objectives.
- Work closely with teams, such as Public Policy and CSR, to develop and implement strategic communications plans that amplify how TikTok is enabling progress for businesses and communities.
- Lead and develop a high-performing team, while fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, and continuous development.
Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications:
- Extensive communications experience and a deep knowledge of consumer, business, and trade/vertical media in the region.
- Able to diplomatically handle change and exhibit sound judgment.
- Demonstrated experience in influencing stakeholders, resolving complex problems and ensuring collaboration within teams and across cross-functional disciplines.
- Proven ability to mentor and inspire high-performing teams across multiple geographies in region.
- Excellent strategic, analytical, and verbal communication skills.
- Previous experience working for a global company is strongly preferred.
- Must be fluent in English & Portuguese. Given the regional LATAM scope, Spanish would be a plus.
About ByteDance Brazil
ByteDance is a global incubator of platforms at the cutting edge of commerce, content, entertainment, and enterprise services - over 2.5 billion people interact with ByteDance products, including TikTok.

Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.
Diversity & Inclusion
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

TikTok Accommodation

Gostou? Então, venha fazer parte da Amarante! Envie seu currículo para nossa equipe.

This global leadership role in cyber security is to manage the Security Operations (SecOps) team responsible for design, implementation and evolution of Canonical security practices, techniques, tools, systems and policies. The team is the primary owner of strategy and practices that determine how Canonical secures its data, internal infrastructure and build processes. They are responsible for assuring the security and integrity of our own infrastructure and product deployments. They design and implement technical security controls that ensure security threats are automatically identified, contained and remediated. The team will also contribute ideas and requirements for Canonical product security, improving the resilience and robustness of all Ubuntu customers and users subject to cyber attack.
As a leader on cyber security in the company, the SecOps team manager will collaborate with our Organisational Learning and Development team to develop playbooks and facilitate SecOps training across Canonical. They will operate in a wider security organisation, run a high performing security team and improve Canonical's security posture. They will lead initiatives to integrate the team's insights into Canonical's broader software development process.
While this is a management position, we expect managers to be expert practitioners, able to lead by example, contribute at the highest level, and assess work based on their own professional experience and skill. Candidates should have deep, hands-on expertise with a range of open source and proprietary security tooling and practices, which they can integrate into a holistic next generation security solution across the breadth of Canonical's interests.
The SecOps team's mission is not only to secure Canonical, but also to contribute to the security of the wider open source ecosystem. They might share knowledge through public presentations and industry events, and share threat intelligence with the wider community or represent Canonical in sector-specific governance bodies.
This role reports to the CISO.
What you will do in this role:

  • Hire and mentor a team of outstanding technical security professionals
  • Define Canonical's SecOps security standards and playbooks
  • Own and drive the architecture and design of the SOC
  • Analyse and improve Canonical's security architecture
  • Evaluate, select and implement new security tools and practices
  • Identify, contain and guide the remediation of security threats and cyber attacks
  • Grow the presence and thought leadership of Canonical SecOps practice
  • Contribute to open source threat intelligence initiatives
  • Drive threat modelling, table top exercises and other SecOps practices across Engineering, IS and Canonical
  • Develop Canonical SecOps learning and development materials
  • Publish blog posts, whitepapers and conference presentations
  • Identify, implement and track SecOps KPIs
  • Plan and deliver SecOps work in the framework of Canonical's agile engineering practice
  • Work with Security leadership to present information and influence change
What we are looking for
  • Proven track record of mitigating with advanced threat actors and nation state threats
  • Expert technical understanding of SOCs from the ground up
  • In depth knowledge of SOC architecture and design including strategies for logging, firewalls, network segmentation, honeypots etc
  • Someone who understands how the SOC works not just how to use it
  • Expert in Linux security
  • Ability to define, implement, automate and measure effective incident response playbooks
  • Knowledge of security architecture and market-leading security tools
  • Experience contributing to, and consuming, threat intelligence feeds
  • Experience in security risk management frameworks such as NIST CSF
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Deep personal motivation to be at the forefront of technology security
  • Leadership and management ability
  • Excellent business English writing and presentation skills
  • Confidence to report security performance metrics with accountability for accuracy and completeness
Optional things we value
  • Experience in offensive or defensive security teams with hands-on ability
  • Experience with open source security tools
  • Experience with security standards such as ISO 27001
  • Experience with security posture management of corporate endpoitns

description:
(2025) Talent Pool- XP Future | Rio de Janeiro Interior (Petrópolis, Teresópolis e Nova Friburgo)

Nossa história começou em 2001, com um pequeno escritório de agentes autônomos de investimentos em Porto Alegre e hoje somos um grande ecossistema de serviços financeiros, mídia e educação.

Chegamos até aqui com a dedicação de equipes talentosas que tiveram garra, determinação, resiliência e, acima de tudo, ambição de fazer o impossível.

  • Foco no cliente: Somos obstinados em superar as expectativas dos nossos clientes.
  • Sonho grande: Miramos no impossível, acreditamos que ele pode se tornar realidade, e chegamos lá juntos.
  • Mente aberta: Nossa abertura para o novo e nossa capacidade de adaptação são o que nos fazem evoluir e melhorar sempre.
  • Espírito empreendedor: Construímos o futuro com nossas próprias mãos com o mais alto nível de comprometimento e sentimento de dono.

Sobre a Oportunidade

Tem perfil comercial, busca transição de carreira e quer fazer parte de um time de alta performance?

Conheça o XP Future - Interior do Rio de Janeiro (Petrópolis, Teresópolis e Nova Friburgo) , uma iniciativa disruptiva para profissionais com alto skill comercial e que desejam se tornar assessores de investimentos.

Essa é uma oportunidade para profissionais que estão em busca de uma transição de carreira e possuem experiência comercial para migrarem para o mercado financeiro.

Na XP Inc. você terá todo o suporte para uma rápida integração e consolidação de seu novo escopo em assessoria, desenvolvendo e aprimorando habilidades de vendas, prospecção de clientes, aprofundamento nos produtos de investimentos e, principalmente, uma imersão no dia a dia do mercado financeiro. Além disso, o programa conta com uma esteira robusta de carreira para que você se torne um profissional comercial de sucesso na corretora, e tire a certificação CPA-20 para se tornar um assessor referência no mercado!

Se você já possui experiência comercial em outros segmentos e deseja fazer uma transição de carreira para o mercado financeiro, conheça os pré-requisitos para iniciar no XP Future logo abaixo!

  • Graduação superior completa ou estar cursando o último ano em período noturno;
  • Experiência comercial (diferencial como Hunter - prospecção de novos negócios);
  • Curiosidade sobre o mundo dos investimentos;
  • Interesse por realizar uma transição de carreira;
  • Estar atuando em outros segmentos de mercado (Meios de pagamentos, adquirência, bebidas, fintechs, etc);
  • Não ser um Assessor de Investimentos ou Agente Autônomo (AAI)

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RF, RV, fundos e outros);
  • CPA-20 ou CEA (Caso o candidato aprovado não tenha a certificação do CPA-20, fornecemos o curso de forma gratuita, em parceria com a Academia Rafael Toro)

Desafios e Impacto

  • Atuação no segmento de Assessoria de Investimentos, sendo responsável por aconselhar e auxiliar a gestão de patrimônio dos clientes;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas, elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos e identificando oportunidades;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico;
  • Disciplina para manter uma alta frequência de contato com clientes de forma online e presencial.


    *Obs.: a contratação é CLT.

Essa vaga é destinada a um pool de rede de talentos a nível Brasil, então pode ser que o retorno demore um pouco a mais do que outras vagas da XP! Em paralelo, também estão abertas as vagas dos XDays XP Future (vagas que acontecerão processos seletivos presenciais na cidade divulgada) para você se aplicar! Essas oportunidades se encontram aqui: Oportunidades XP Inc. ou

Triagem inicial : Análise do currículo para verificar a adequação às qualificações e requisitos da vaga.

Testes gerais : Avaliação do alinhamento cultural com o teste da Mindsight e teste de raciocínio lógico da Predictive Index.

Entrevista com a equipe de Recrutamento : Discussão sobre as expectativas em relação à vaga e aos objetivos profissionais.

Entrevista com a liderança : Uma conversa para discutir sua visão e como você pode contribuir para a equipe e a empresa.

Entrevista com Head Comercial : Conversa para discutir sobre o seu perfil e características necessárias para contribuir com a operação.

Entrevista focada em cultura : Exploração dos valores e princípios da empresa para garantir um bom encaixe cultural.

Oferta : Apresentação da proposta de trabalho, incluindo detalhes sobre remuneração e benefícios.

Por fim, abaixo segue o vídeo sobre o Fator XP! Para você se reconhecer cada vez mais no nosso propósito como empresa e cultura:

  • Saúde e bem-estar: plano de saúde, plano odontológico, Gympass, Zenklub, VA, VR, New Value, seguro de vida.
  • Maternidade e Paternidade: auxílio creche para pais e mães, licença maternidade de 6 meses, licença paternidade de 20 dias.
  • Só na XP Inc.: assessoria de investimento e acesso a fundos de investimentos exclusivos.

Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: presencial para frentes de negócio e híbrido para as demais equipes. É importante ressaltar que todos os colaboradores precisam morar na localidade da vaga (nossa sede está localizada na cidade de São Paulo e é onde temos o maior número de posições), já que temos atividades que exigem a presença física para promover a colaboração e os rituais da nossa cultura. Esses encontros são organizados de acordo com as orientações dos líderes e as particularidades de cada rotina, para que nossos colaboradores possam exercer suas jornadas de trabalho com liberdade e autonomia.

description:
Estamos revolucionando a forma como as relações de confiança são criadas e nutridas.
A paixão pelo que fazemos alimenta nossa inquietude coletiva para criar as tecnologias de ponta que são referência em nosso mercado. Acreditamos que onde há confiança, há evolução!
Como Será Seu Dia a Dia Na Idwall

  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com a equipe de vendas para entender profundamente os desafios e necessidades dos clientes, indo além da demanda inicial para identificar oportunidades de melhoria e transformação;
  • Atuar com perfil consultivo, cocriando soluções com os clientes e ajudando-os a visualizar o valor das ofertas da idwall de forma estratégica;
  • Conduzir conversas estruturadas de descoberta (discovery), entendendo o contexto do cliente e propondo a combinação mais eficaz de produtos e serviços do portfólio da idwall;
  • Apoiar na tomada de decisão comercial provendo uma visão técnica clara, conectada com as dores do cliente e com as capacidades do produto;
  • Articular (por meio de apresentações escritas e orais) soluções para públicos técnicos e não técnicos, garantindo clareza, alinhamento e engajamento;
  • Apoiar os esforços de vendas com profundo conhecimento de produtos e necessidades por segmento de mercado;
  • Trabalhar com a equipe de Customer Success para garantir uma transição fluida entre pré e pós-venda, alinhando expectativas e garantindo valor desde o início da jornada do cliente;
  • Ser referência técnica e consultiva dentro do time, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento de boas práticas e abordagens estratégicas junto a clientes complexos.

Para assumir esse papel, você precisa ter as seguintes habilidades:
  • Formação em Engenharia, Tecnologia ou área similares;
  • Experiência em engenharia de vendas, com soluções SaaS, para clientes de grande porte;
  • Conhecimento generalista de arquitetura de software (APIs, Mobile, Segurança, Banco de Dados, Ambientes de alta disponibilidade, Cloud Computing);
  • Excelente comunicação escrita e verbal. Capaz de sintetizar análises complexas, apresentar pontos relevantes de maneira simples e efetiva para uma audiência diversa;
  • Trabalha bem em um ambiente de mudanças rápidas, trabalhando com diversas tasks e projetos ao mesmo tempo. Lidar bem com mudanças de prioridades.
  • Foco no cliente e excelentes habilidades de comunicação;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente e ser proativo;
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento e apresentação eficaz de apresentações;
  • Excelentes habilidades analíticas e de solução de problemas;
  • Disponibilidade para viajar dentro do Brasil para reuniões com clientes.
  • Inglês avançado para leitura de materiais técnicos e participação em interações com stakeholders internacionais;

Serão Considerados Diferenciais
  • Experiência atuando em empresas de consultoria estratégica ou empresas com modelo SaaS B2B em contextos de crescimento acelerado;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas como Salesforce, Looker, Grafana, Datadog e SQL;
  • Vivência em setores regulados (financeiro, telecom, saúde, etc.) ou com soluções voltadas para compliance e verificação de identidade; Atuação prévia em projetos com múltiplos stakeholders e complexidade técnica alta, sendo ponte entre áreas técnicas e de negócios;
  • Capacidade de gerar insights de mercado e colaborar com Produto em melhorias e novas funcionalidades com base em feedbacks de clientes.

O Que Você Vai Encontrar Aqui
  • Propósito

Aliamos o seu desenvolvimento e objetivos de carreira às transformações que trazemos para milhares de brasileiros em nosso dia a dia.
  • Trabalhamos com gente incrível

A revolução que estamos causando no mundo está sendo feita por pessoas e profissionais excelentes. Gente que está sempre aberta a feedbacks e que segue em busca da melhoria contínua. Trabalhar com pessoas assim, nos incentiva a evoluir também e nos puxa na direção de quem desejamos nos tornar.
  • Crescemos juntos

Entendemos que é possível aprender algo novo diariamente e que a prática de aceitar desafios que parecem impossíveis, pode nos levar ao crescimento que queremos vivenciar para a idwall e para a sua carreira também.

HDR Engineering is currently seeking a Transmission Line Project Manager to join our growing and nationally ranked team of Power Delivery professionals.
Opportunities are available in these preferred locations: Austin, Ann Arbor, Boise, Bismark, Billings, Charlotte, Chicago, Denver, Irvine, Fort Worth, Houston, Honolulu, Kansas City, Madison, Minneapolis, Missoula, Omaha, Phoenix, Portland (OR & ME), Richmond, Raleigh Sacramento/Folsom, San Diego, Seattle, Spokane, St Louis, Syracuse.
Primary Responsibilities
As part of a well-established global Power Delivery practice, you will have the opportunity to manage Transmission Line projects of all sizes and complexities, domestically and potentially abroad. Additionally, you will have the desire to roll up your sleeves and work with the design teams to help execute these projects.
The primary duties of a Transmission Line Project Manager include executing and managing all aspects of transmission line engineering projects, including scope and/or proposal development, project team development and assignment, project execution, quality control, scope, schedule, and budget management, and project closeout. Projects may include routing/siting, public involvement, environmental permitting, real estate acquisition, construction management, or other services.
As a Transmission Line Project Manager, your role will encompass the following:

  • Managing and leading projects and programs throughout the entire life cycle.
  • Working independently and/or directing, mentoring, training, and/or supervising one or more Project Engineers, EITs, Coordinators, Designers, CADD Technicians, and administrative staff.
  • Providing project team member oversight over workload, schedule, quality, utilization, morale, and performance.
  • As applicable, being responsible for overseeing non-engineering components of projects and programs, such as public engagement, County/State/Federal agency engagement, permitting, right of way acquisition, and construction management.
  • Leading the QA/QC process per HDR’s Quality Management Systems (QMS) requirements with a commitment to delivering services and work products that exceed client quality expectations.
  • Supporting client management and at times engaging in broader business development activities with existing and target clients in the region and beyond.
  • Coordinating with Area and Regional leadership and HDR’s Talent Acquisition team to develop a hiring plan to help build and grow a group of professionals to meet program and practice needs.
  • Ability to workshare with staff in multiple offices to execute projects.
  • Represents HDR to support marketing and proposal development for new opportunities.
